cc @eerhardt @brunolins16 the APIs above would provide a mechanism to perform untyped, linker-safe serialization. 

They can be used as an alternative to the proposal in #74492, via the workaround proposed in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/74492#issuecomment-1262720594

review_comments: This method is not part of the original proposal per se, however I've added it in the spirit of API review feedback: we weren't exposing any weakly typed `DeserializeAsyncEnumerable` methods until today, so it made sense to include a `JsonSerializerOptions` variant for completeness.
